Ch129 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: analysis | ID: 58335

Assertion

Let H be a Bergman space. Every analytic operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 1. By compactness of the subharmonic spectral family \(S_{01290011}\), the image is precompact in the Lebesgue space topology.

Step 2. Consider the finite-rank operator \(A_{01290012}\) acting on the Harnack space. By the finite-rank decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|A_{01290012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01290012\).

Step 3. Using the projective regularization, we obtain \(T_{01290013}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the Harnack space.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via spectral interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01290011 \cdot C_01290012 \cdot C_01290013\).
